value.workload: Sweden Central only for workload compute, application data, storage and backups; retain the existing single-region boundary for non-Entra services, monitoring and other dependencies.

Most customer data within the EU Data Boundary is not an absolute no-EU-egress guarantee.
value.applicability_prerequisite: Architecture must verify tenant creation/provisioning and exact identity-product coverage for workforce and external Volunteer sign-in, including Entra External ID external-tenant applicability; no applicable tenant or deployed commitment is verified here.
value.excluded_permissions: No general global-service, monitoring, storage or other integrated-service exception; no automatic permission for optional multitenant collaboration, Application Proxy or other optional cross-boundary features; no law, effective-policy or security-baseline waiver.
value.acceptance_scope: Project Stakeholders accept this narrow exception as meeting their project GDPR requirements. This is not independent certification, blanket GDPR compliance assurance, architecture approval or Azure read/write, spend, Production or deployment authority.
